metadata.description: Name of the environment — used as a prefix for all resources
API container image (set by azd deploy)
Agents container image (set by azd deploy)
Ingestion container image (set by azd deploy)
Principal ID for RBAC role assignments (set by azd)
Developer IP address to allow through Cosmos DB firewall (for local seed scripts, etc.)
Azure OpenAI model deployment SKU. Use GlobalStandard for dev/staging (draws from global capacity pool) and Standard for production (regional capacity).
When true, restricts Cosmos DB network access to Azure Portal and Azure-services IPs only. Set to true for production; leave false for dev/staging to allow fully open public access.
Deployment environment tier — controls auth policies (e.g. Azure Maps local auth)

properties.description: Fires when a simulation tenant exceeds error threshold; filtered by tenant_id custom dimension

allOf.query: requests | extend tenant_id = tostring(customDimensions.tenant_id) | where tenant_id startswith "sim-" | where success == false | summarize FailedCount = count() by tenant_id | where FailedCount > 20
